newsitem.title: USA: ERD Waste sees loss at about $13 mln.
newsitem.headline: ERD Waste sees loss at about $13 mln.

text.p: ERD Waste Corp said on Friday that it estimates the loss from the discontinued incineration operations at its Long Beach facility resulting from the write-down of property, plant and equipment value and certain related liabilities and costs at $13 million.
The loss would be recorded as of September 30, 1996, the end of the company's fiscal year. ERD expects that the restructured company would be profitable in 1997.
ERD Waste said it opened a used oil filter recycling facility in Waco, Texas as well as a second absorbent products manufacturing facility in East Stroudsburg, Penn.
